name: CONBEXTRA GP2(25KG)
description: Fosroc Conbextra GP2 is a high-flow, non-shrink cementitious grout designed for structural anchoring, baseplate grouting, and bearing pad applications. It provides high early and ultimate compressive strength, ensuring critical load transfer and long-term structural integrity in demanding institutional and industrial environments.

name: RENDROC PLUG( 15 KG)
description: Fosroc Hendroc Plug (15 kg) is a rapid-setting, hydraulic cement mortar formulated for the instantaneous arresting of active water leaks and seepage in concrete and masonry substrates. Its high-early strength and expansive non-shrink properties deliver immediate structural stabilization, minimizing downtime and costly excavation in commercial construction and infrastructure repair projects.

name: BRUSHBOND ULTAFLEX GREY(25KG)
description: Fosroc Brushbond Ultraflex Grey is a two-component, polymer-modified cementitious waterproofing membrane applied via brush or trowel to concrete and masonry surfaces. It provides an elastomeric, seamless barrier that accommodates structural movement, ensuring long-term asset protection and damp-proofing in demanding infrastructure and commercial construction projects.

name: CONBEXTRA GP2 (30 KGS)
description: FOSROC Conbextra GP2 is a high-flow, shrinkage-compensated cementitious grout engineered for precision baseplate grouting, stanchion bases, and structural anchoring. Its formulation ensures high early and ultimate compressive strengths, providing load-bearing stability and long-term structural integrity for demanding institutional and heavy industrial applications.

name: RENDROC PLUG( 15 KG)
description: Fosroc Hendroc Plug is a rapid-setting, hydraulic mortar designed for the immediate stoppage of active water leaks in concrete and masonry structures. Its fast-curing formulation provides institutional asset protection by instantly sealing structural breaches and preventing moisture-induced degradation prior to waterproofing repairs.

name: BRUSHBOND RFX-30KG
description: FOSROC BRUSHBOND RFX-30KG is a polymer-modified, cementitious waterproof coating applied via brush or spray to concrete and masonry substrates. It provides a seamless, high-performance moisture barrier that protects critical institutional infrastructure against hydrostatic pressure, carbonation, and chloride attack.

name: NITOCOTE CM 210 GREY(23KG)
description: Nitocote CM 210 Grey is a two-component, polymer-modified cementitious coating designed for waterproofing and protecting concrete structures against water ingress and carbonation. It provides institutional value by extending the lifecycle of critical infrastructure such as reservoirs, bridges, and sewage treatment plants through seamless, elastomeric barrier protection.

name: RUSHBOND ROOFGUARD PREMIUM(20L)
description: Fosroc Rushbond Roofguard Premium (20L) is a high-performance liquid-applied waterproofing membrane designed for seamless application on concrete and metal roof substrates. It delivers long-term asset protection and structural integrity, significantly reducing lifecycle maintenance costs for institutional and commercial facilities.

name: CONBEXTRA GP2 (30 KGS)
description: FOSROC Conbextra GP2 is a high-flow, non-shrink cementitious grout utilized for structural load-bearing applications, machinery baseplate installation, and cavity filling. Its controlled expansion system ensures continuous positive contact and high early compressive strength, minimizing equipment downtime and mitigating structural failure risks in demanding institutional projects.

name: NITOPROOF WB PRIMER(6L)
description: Fosroc Nitoproof WB Primer (6L) is a water-based bituminous emulsion designed to seal and prepare porous concrete substrates prior to the application of waterproofing membranes. By ensuring optimal bond strength and minimizing substrate dusting, this primer enhances the long-term durability and structural integrity of below-grade and institutional waterproofing systems.

name: CONPLAST WL (20 LTR)
description: Fosroc Conplast WL is a liquid waterproofing admixture formulated to reduce permeability and enhance water resistance in mass concrete and cement mortars. It improves workability while minimizing shrinkage, ensuring long-term structural integrity and lower maintenance costs in below-grade and water-retaining institutional applications.

name: NITOBOND AR ( 25L)
description: Fosroc Nitobond AR is a single-component, acrylic emulsion-based bonding agent designed to structurally key cementitious repair mortars and screeds to concrete substrates. It enhances flexural strength, reduces permeability, and provides durable interfacial adhesion for commercial and infrastructure rehabilitation projects.
